leakage_rules: No authority_family may occur in more than one split.
No document_family may occur in more than one split.
No authority/document group_id may occur in more than one split.

future_group_assignment.algorithm: Build connected components across authority_family and document_family. A component touching one frozen split inherits it. A component touching conflicting frozen splits is rejected for adjudication; it is never auto-assigned. Only a wholly new component uses sha256(seed + ':' + canonical_component_id), first 8 hex digits modulo 100.
